list.title: AutoGenFeatureConfiguration
list.description: One row per SharePoint list or library that should receive an auto-generated request number. Create it on the site collection root. The configuration web part can create this list.

columns.notes: Built in on a generic list. Friendly name of the rule.
Absolute https URL of the list or library to number. AllItems.aspx is accepted. The web URL is derived from this path.
GUID returned by GetList for TargetListUrl. One active row per GUID.
Internal name of a single-line text column on the target list, for example RequestNumber. Create that column on the target list yourself.
UTC tokens {yyyy} {yy} {MM} {dd} {HH} {mm} {seq} {seq:n}. {seq} uses PadLength. {seq:n} overrides it. A formula without {seq} is rejected.
Owned by the Azure Function. New rows start at 0. The configuration web part does not write this field on edit.
None never resets. Day, Month, and Year compare UTC period keys derived from LastResetDate.
Owned by the Azure Function. Empty does not wipe CurrentCount. The first issued number stamps this date.
Inactive rows are ignored. Missing is inactive.
Default width for {seq}. 0 means no padding.
Written by RegisterWebhook after SharePoint accepts the spoWebhook subscription. Changing TargetListGuid clears it so the next save can register again.
